# Stephen Irving

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P22](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0022)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) (child)

## Appearance

Stephen Irving is a tall, handsome middle-aged man with iron-gray hair and deep-set, dark blue eyes. His strong, sad face features splendid modeling around the brow and chin.

_Sources: [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P22](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0022)_

## Personality

Stephen Irving is a high-strung, sensitive, and reserved man who carefully hides his deep and tender nature from the world. He is also described as being very proud.

_Sources: [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P8](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0008), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P19](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0019)_

## History

Stephen Irving, the father of [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md), asked [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to carry a message to Miss Lavendar to ask if he could visit her at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). After receiving permission, he arrived at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) ushered him inside, leading to a romantic reconciliation as he and Miss Lavendar walked affectionately in the garden. He subsequently married Miss Lavendar in a wonderful ceremony at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) before the newlyweds were seen off by their guests.

_Sources: [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P17](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0017), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P21](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0021), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P35](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0035), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P57](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0057), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P59](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0059), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P64](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0064), +6 more_

## Quotes

> “With a hug like a bear’s,” said Mr. Irving, putting his arms around Paul’s shoulder smilingly. “I hardly knew my boy, he had grown so big and brown and sturdy.”
>
> — Stephen Irving — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P27](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0027)

> "In Paul’s last letter he spoke of going with you to visit an old . . . friend of mine . . . Miss Lewis at the stone house in Grafton. Do you know her well?"
>
> — Stephen Irving — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P30](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0030)

> "Yes, I believe you are. Well, I am going to ask a favor of you. I would like to go and see Miss Lavendar if she will let me. Will you ask her if I may come?"
>
> — Stephen Irving — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P35](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0035)

> "There is nothing changed about this house or garden since I was here twenty-five years ago. It makes me feel young again."
>
> — Stephen Irving — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P60](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0060)

> "I wonder how much you know,"
>
> — Stephen Irving — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P33](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0033)

## Relationships

### [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/lavendar-lewis--stephen-irving.md)

Stephen and Miss Lavendar were engaged twenty-five years in the past before reconnecting later in life. Upon his return, Stephen asks [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) to inquire if he may visit Miss Lavendar at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), leading to an affectionate reunion between the two in her garden. Shortly thereafter, they marry in a wonderful ceremony at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), departing together as newlyweds.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P36](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0036), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P9](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0009), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P17](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0017), +12 more_

- Romantically involved with — engaged twenty-five years ago  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P36](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0036), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P9](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0009), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P22](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0022)</sub>

### [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/paul-irving--stephen-irving.md)

Stephen is the father of [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md). He meets [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) during a visit to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) before reuniting with Miss Lavendar. Later, [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) is present alongside the other guests as Stephen marries Miss Lavendar at her home.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P8](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0008), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P17](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0017), +9 more_
